Les Mills was a prominent New Zealand figure who competed in four Olympics, served as the mayor of Auckland, and founded the Les Mills fitness empire, which popularized choreographed group exercise classes worldwide.

Even in a life of service, the commercialization of fitness can sometimes overshadow the original intent of community-based health, though this is minor here.
